purpose: Test whether a host adapter carries the JM sovereign agent without changing body identity, authority, routing meaning or proof boundaries.
architecture: SOVEREIGN CORE → PORTABLE CONTRACTS → CAPABILITY NEGOTIATION → HOST ADAPTER → HOST CONTACT → CONSEQUENCE → RETURNED TRACE

gates.meaning: Adapter points to the canonical sovereign core rather than copying/redefining identity.
Adapter can load/consume the canonical portable contracts or an exact declared carrier projection.
Host capabilities are explicit; unsupported capabilities remain visible rather than silently emulated.
Host cannot become source/current-head/owner authority merely by carrying the body.
Same input/current carriers preserve bounded routing meaning at the adapter boundary.
The actual named host surface was physically contacted, not inferred from CI/transport.
The tested lane returned an observable consequence or deterministic result.
Adapter state/carriers preserve a documented re-entry or recovery route.
The owner/device surface itself was directly contacted at the exact claimed scope.

evidence_rule: Every PASS gate must name at least one durable evidence reference. OPEN is an honest boundary, not a failure. NA is permitted only when the descriptor class explicitly excludes that gate.
no_inflation_rule: An adapter may claim only the highest proof level whose required gates are all PASS.
target_scope_rule: Proof belongs to the exact adapter + host surface + consequence class. A browser carrier PASS does not crown an Android adapter; an MCP runtime PASS does not crown ChatGPT inline contact.

tester.live_local_rule: CI must execute both reference runtimes and compare byte-identical core capsules for the same queries.
tester.static_route_rule: Non-local adapters are audited against durable evidence and explicit OPEN gates; the tester must not simulate missing host contact.

keeper: CHANGE THE PLUG, NOT THE BODY.
